meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: Claude 将代码审查评论压缩成每行一条，按 `L<行号>: <问题>. <修复>.` 格式输出，包含位置、问题和具体修复建议。它去掉客套话和对冲语，用 🔴/🟡/🔵/❓ 标记严重性。它只输出可直接粘贴的评论，不直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你使用 `/caveman-review`、说“review this PR”或“review the diff”时触发，它会接管代码审查评论的风格。

say.note: Claude 以一行一条的格式输出评论。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 看下这次改动

howto.what_en: Claude turns code review comments into one-line items in `L<line>: <problem>. <fix>.` format with location, issue and a concrete fix. It strips pleasantries and hedging, uses 🔴/🟡/🔵/❓ severity markers, and only outputs paste-ready comments — never edits code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you use `/caveman-review`, say 'review this PR', or 'review the diff'.

say_en.note: Comments come out one line each.
Location, problem and fix per line.
